title: Assessment of self-reported and clinically reported bruxism in studies on selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors and serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors use
html: The authors critically evaluated whether evidence supports an association between selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors or serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors and reported bruxism, and they analyzed possible causal inferences.
